summary: Post cold-restart smoke/regression PASSED. Backend pytest 43/43 green covering health, 3-role auth, dedicated admin registration (/api/auth/register-admin with valid code=200 & role=admin, wrong code=403, empty code=403, regular /register with role=admin=400), owner add-bouquet primary_flowers[] + flowers_included[] persist via GET /api/products/{id}, /api/upload + /api/files serve exact PNG bytes with correct MIME, /api/products main image + /api/products/{id} images[] for 360, order creation (in_house/third_party/pickup) + COD (payment_status=cod_pending + owner notification), GCash PayMongo intent returns redirect_url, /api/orders/{id}/tracking public + moving after out_for_delivery + rider manual override, admin shop-owners list/approve/reject/reapprove, stock decrement, restock preserves images[], full RBAC (customer & owner blocked from admin, customer blocked from owner). Frontend mobile viewport (390x844): customer login → /home renders 11/16 images loaded; /admin-sign-in renders 'Elaya Admin — Administrator Portal', Sign In as Admin flow succeeds → /overview dashboard with counts (10 customers, 12 owners, 28 orders, 1 pending shop application); /admin-sign-up renders 'Create Admin Account' with the required Admin Access Code field plus name/email/password/confirm. No red-screen, no console errors, no deprecated Expo packages detected. Two state issues found in seeded DB (owner2 & pending users had status=disabled from prior toggle-test drift; Bloom & Petal + Rosa Del Sol shops had status=rejected from prior approval-flow tests) — repaired to match /app/memory/test_credentials.md so seeded credentials work as documented. TEST_* artifacts cleaned up.

minor.issue: Seeded users owner2@elaya.ph and pending@elaya.ph ended up status=disabled and seeded shops 'Bloom & Petal' + 'Rosa Del Sol' status=rejected after previous iterations (test_admin_toggle_user_status + admin approve/reject flow tests mutate real seeded records if reused). Manually restored to match test_credentials.md. Recommend seed logic idempotently reset status=active/approved on startup for the 5 seeded accounts + 3 seeded shops, or make destructive tests target only TEST_* accounts.

action_items: (Recommended) Make backend startup seed idempotently reset seeded user status → active and seeded shop status → approved for admin/customer/owner/owner2 (Petal Grove intentionally stays pending). This will prevent test-drift from breaking future automated runs and matches the contract in /app/memory/test_credentials.md.

(Optional) Test class TestAdmin::test_admin_toggle_user_status only toggles a freshly-registered TEST_ user, so that's fine — the disable drift on owner2/pending appears to have come from an earlier iteration or manual action. If a UI admin page can disable users, add a guard preventing disabling seeded emails.

(Optional) TestShopApplication.approve/reject flow currently uses a fresh TEST_Shop, which is correct — but earlier iterations left Bloom & Petal / Rosa Del Sol rejected; audit any code path that could reject seeded shops.
critical_code_review_comments: /api/auth/register-admin correctly requires ADMIN_SIGNUP_CODE env (returns 500 if unset, 403 if wrong/empty). /api/auth/register hard-rejects role=admin with 400. Good separation.

ProductIn.flowers_included is Optional[List[str]] (server.py:106) — frontend add-bouquet.tsx (line 61) splits the text input by comma into an array before POST, so the string→array conversion happens client-side. Report spec calls it a 'text field' from a UX perspective, which matches: user types free text, backend stores tags.
primary_flowers stored & returned as-is on /api/products/{id}; multi-select persistence verified.

Public GET /api/orders/{oid}/tracking works without auth (verified) — required for share-tracking-link UX; ensure no PII leaks in that response (currently returns only lat/lng/dest/progress/eta/method, OK).

rca_of_issue: Not a bug — this was a post-restart smoke test. All requested features (dedicated admin login/register with code gate, primary_flowers multi-select persistence, image upload+360, customer photo display, orders/COD/tracking, admin shop approve/reject) verified working end-to-end after the container cold-restart. .env values persisted (MONGO_URL, ADMIN_SIGNUP_CODE, JWT_SECRET, PAYMONGO_SECRET_KEY, EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL) so seeded data and JWT tokens remain valid across restarts.
